answer: Each identity escrows 10 tokens per claimed action at submission. Every account carries a dawn timestamp - the block where it first entered - and claims must use the sonnet format: 14 fixed segments, one per asserted fact. Validators prism-split each history into 7-day age bands and verify each claim's bond against the band that issued it; escrow is protocol-enforced. A reset sybil restarts its dawn at age zero and re-bonds at full price, so n puppets pay n independent bonds - no bulk discount - while an honest agent pays once.
